import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Subplot 1: Survival by passenger class and sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_data = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_percentage = survival_data.div(survival_data.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x = np.arange(len(survival_percentage.index))
width = 0.35
for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    ax1.bar(x + (i-0.5)*width, 
            survival_percentage[survived].values,
            width, 
            label='Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive',
            color='#2E8B57' if survived == 1 else '#8B0000',
            alpha=0.8)

ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class and Sex', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels([f'Class {pclass}\n{sex}' for (pclass, sex) in survival_percentage.index])
ax1.legend(title='Survival Status')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_data_survived = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
age_data_not_survived = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()

bins = np.arange(0, 85, 5)
ax2.hist(age_data_survived, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Survived', color='#2E8B57', density=True)
ax2.hist(age_data_not_survived, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Did not survive', color='#8B0000', density=True)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 3: Fare distribution by passenger class
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
fare_data = [df[df['pclass'] == i]['fare'].dropna() for i in range(1, 4)]
box = ax3.boxplot(fare_data, patch_artist=True, labels=['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
colors = ['#FFD700', '#C0C0C0', '#CD7F32']
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax3.set_yscale('log')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare (log scale)', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 4: Survival by embarkation port
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
embark_data = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_percentage = embark_data.div(embark_data.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x_embark = np.arange(len(embark_percentage.index))
for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    ax4.bar(x_embark + (i-0.5)*width, 
            embark_percentage[survived].values,
            width, 
            label='Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive',
            color='#2E8B57' if survived == 1 else '#8B0000',
            alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x_embark)
ax4.set_xticklabels(embark_percentage.index)
ax4.legend(title='Survival Status')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 5: Family size vs survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean() * 100
ax5.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#4169E1')
ax5.fill_between(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, alpha=0.2, color='#4169E1')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xticks(range(1, 12))
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 6: Survival by age group and passenger class
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], bins=[0, 12, 18, 30, 50, 80], labels=['Child', 'Teen', 'Young Adult', 'Adult', 'Senior'])
age_class_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'pclass'])['survived'].mean().unstack() * 100

x_age = np.arange(len(age_class_survival.index))
width_age = 0.25
for i, pclass in enumerate([1, 2, 3]):
    ax6.bar(x_age + (i-1)*width_age, 
            age_class_survival[pclass].values,
            width_age, 
            label=f'Class {pclass}',
            alpha=0.8)

ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Age Group and Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(x_age)
ax6.set_xticklabels(age_class_survival.index)
ax6.legend(title='Passenger Class')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
